8154.title: Chromium discovery and nonstandard Keychain metadata
8154.rootCauseOneLine: Generic Chromium discovery derives Keychain identifiers from the storage name; a nonstandard secret-store service causes keychainItemMissing despite readable profile storage.
8154.proposedFix: Verify native browser metadata on macOS, then register explicit known-source metadata and cover import at the service boundary; a dedicated ID changes the shared schema and is outside the automatic simple-fix gate.
8154.caveats: Synthetic mechanism only; actual browser installation, native Keychain identifiers and two-profile behavior are unverified. Complete reproduction test and output are inline per public reports repository policy.
